1c5933994a3ea923.speaker: ALEX
1c5933994a3ea923.text: The meeting starts in five minutes. Someone asks what AI changes for your team. What do you say?

e16c269d4fd8fb76.speaker: RUFUS
e16c269d4fd8fb76.text: Something about transformation. Then look thoughtfully at a window.

dd3736b3fb62ff02.speaker: JAMIE
dd3736b3fb62ff02.text: Or have an actual answer. What changed, why it matters, and what you still need to check.

e8f8845fae240839.speaker: ALEX
e8f8845fae240839.text: That's our conversation on The AI Edge. Three perspectives. Useful questions. Occasionally, a useful Rufus.

0bd3544f85f5bd41.speaker: JAMIE
0bd3544f85f5bd41.text: Make sense of the AI stories shaping your day. Follow The AI Edge wherever you listen.

b12d08ff816b667c.speaker: ALEX
b12d08ff816b667c.text: Prefer the written briefing? Subscribe to The Ledger at the ledgr dot io. That's ledgr, without the second e.

3e6ebe793470735a.speaker: JAMIE
3e6ebe793470735a.text: Listen with The AI Edge. Read with The Ledger. Start with the newsletter at the ledgr dot io.

82d4e1365fb9e605.speaker: JAMIE
82d4e1365fb9e605.text: I've read twelve AI headlines, Alex. I now have thirteen opinions and absolutely no plan.

eff59b45add0f44a.speaker: RUFUS
eff59b45add0f44a.text: Excellent. You're qualified to chair a panel.

c297c704e9605d11.speaker: ALEX
c297c704e9605d11.text: Start here: what changed, who wins, and what do you do next?

541b048b24e18610.speaker: JAMIE
541b048b24e18610.text: That's why we argue it through on The AI Edge. You bring the curiosity. Rufus brings the unnecessary commentary.

c5505a9205427bc1.speaker: ALEX
c5505a9205427bc1.text: Would you let AI write an email to your boss?

d796680bac3d0216.speaker: JAMIE
d796680bac3d0216.text: Draft it? Absolutely. Send it without me reading it? Absolutely not.

9f5580df9086f22b.speaker: RUFUS
9f5580df9086f22b.text: A small but rather career-preserving distinction.

2f3cafbba62a9308.speaker: ALEX
2f3cafbba62a9308.text: The exciting part and the awkward questions. We make room for both on The AI Edge.
